pr_title: various context related cleanups to rest.Request
pr_body:
Pre-cleanup pulled out of https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/87597

* Move all usage of r.ctx to the beginning of Do, DoRaw, Stream, Watch
* Move tryThrottle from Do and DoRaw into request()
* Make request() and tryThrottle take a context
* In request(), remove the timeout context setting out of the loop

These changes should be entirely behavior preserving.

/kind cleanup
/sig api-machinery

Fixes #86590

```release-note
NONE
```

review_comments:
nit (here and other places), flip this to:
```go
ctx := r.ctx
if ctx == nil {
  ctx = context.Background()
}
```

avoids an allocation, and later when ctx becomes a parameter to this method, we can just drop the `ctx := r.ctx` line
oh, unless we require ctx to be non-nil in all invocations... in which case this is temporary/fine
